item.title: Jaloni Cambridge Becomes Fourth Ohio State Women’s Basketball Player to Score 40 or More Points in A Game
item.description: Jaloni Cambridge had one of the most prolific scoring games in Ohio State women’s basketball history on Wednesday night. The sophomore guard scored 41 points in the Buckeyes’ 78-69 win at Illinois, becoming just the fourth player in Ohio State women’s basketball history to top 40 points in a game. Cambridge made 15 shots on 25 attempts, including two 3-pointers on five attempts, and went nine of 12 from the free-throw line to reach her career-high scoring total. item.title: Ohio State Safety Keenan Nelson Jr. Enters the Transfer Portal
item.description: Keenan Nelson Jr. will end his college football career at a third school. After transferring to Ohio State from South Carolina in 2024, Nelson is back in the transfer portal with one year of eligibility remaining. Nelson arrived in Columbus as a four-star transfer after spending two seasons with the Gamecocks. item.title: Ohio State Takes Control at Oregon With 21-0 Second-Half Run, Wins 72-62
item.description: Just when the Ducks flew back to make things close in the early in the second half against Ohio State, the Buckeyes shot them down for good with a massive run.
